newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - August 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - August 15.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on August 15. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bank Indonesia, the central bank, has decided to allow the rupiah to float, sending the currency to uncharted territory. The floating of the rupiah was nade effective on Thursday.

President Suharto has called on financial market authorities to build investor confidence in order to avoid capital flight. He said once investors lost confidence in the country's capital market they would easily move their funds to capital markets in other countries.
A senior historian has said the government has not made any significant changes in its staunch approach towards stability in 52 years of independence.
